description: Download URLs for files the person owns, each with its name, size and sha256, valid for 10 minutes; no cookie needed (curl -L works). Narrow with fileIds or an edition; zip: true adds one link for the whole product; color recolours a recolourable product's SVGs (their names become <name>-<rrggbb>.svg and their sha256 is the recoloured file's). To put files into the project, download_to_folder does the download and the checksum for you.

color.description: Recolourable products only (get_product's recolor is not null; the Illustrations shelf): the accent colour their SVGs come in, as hex, e.g. "#2f9e44" (the brand colour of the project). Leave it out for the files as drawn.

edition.description: Narrow a product sold in editions (planners, calendars) to one. Leave an axis out to keep all of it.

zip.description: Also a link to the whole product as one zip.

name: get_download_links
title: Download links
